name: admission-marks-after-projection-limits
body: Three limits on the admission wiring. (1) The pending-removal clear is authored as raw Cypher in `src/session.rs` through the held handle's `conn()` seam, so the ledger's query vocabulary now lives in two files — this admission clear and `record_pending_removal`/`pending_removals` in `src/artifacts/db.rs`; upgrade by folding the admission clear into phase-2's `clear_pending_state` so one place owns the ledger's statements. (2) The marks and ledger records run after the projection, as the task orders, so a mark or ledger failure returns `Err` with the projection already landed (also cached by the at-most-once client id); upgrade when admission gains a transactional wrapper, or accept phase-4's pending-state discard-and-rebuild as the repair for a half-applied admission. (3) Admission reads the pending-removal ledger once per mutation — a pre-admission snapshot beside the ledger read `node_files_from_db` already performs — so a large durable spec pays two ledger scans per admission; upgrade by threading the reconstruction's ledger set out of `node_files_from_db` if per-mutation admission over a large durable spec becomes hot.
